parties: India Glycols Limited (parent/listed) and Ennature Bio Pharma Limited (subsidiary)
headline: India Glycols: Material Update on Ennature Bio Pharma Scheme of Arrangement
sum: India Glycols received observation letters from NSE and BSE (dated 17 and 19 November 2025 respectively) in relation to a Scheme of Arrangement involving subsidiary Ennature Bio Pharma Limited; the material update was disclosed to exchanges on 21 August 2026.
implication: Observation letters from both stock exchanges mark regulatory approval of the scheme's listed-entity disclosure obligations; subsequent step is likely NCLT sanction or scheme implementation conditional on shareholder/creditor approval.
detail: India Glycols Limited notified both NSE and BSE of a material update concerning a Scheme of Arrangement with Ennature Bio Pharma Limited. The observation letters (NSE/LIST/48932 of 17 November 2025 and BSE DCS/AMAL/TS/R37/3905/2025-26 of 19 November 2025) were issued by the stock exchanges, indicating regulatory consideration of the scheme's listing implications and disclosure requirements. The exact consideration, demerger/merger mechanics, and NCLT bench reference are not detailed in the available source material.
